Auto Takeoff · zoomed check · engine run on your PDFs

Zoomed Takeoff Check

Every sheet is split into parts and each part is checked zoomed in, one by one, the way you would check it in Revu. Below is the final take-off on six sheets from three of your drawing sets, with the parts each sheet was split into and every markup drawn on it.

SplitThe drawing area is cut into 4, 6, 9 or more parts, more for a busy sheet. Parts overlap by about 2 ft.
Zoom inEvery small shape and every line in the part is read at full detail, curves included.
Check one by oneColumns, beams, joists and deck callouts are checked. Wrong ones (arrows, grid bubbles) are removed.
JoinThe parts are put back together. Anything still not taken off is listed per part.

What the zoomed check still can't do

  • Deck on a decking plan with no beams taken off (AC Retreat S4.03a) gets no bay yet. Teach me your deck rules and I'll add them, like the walls.
  • Beams with no size printed are added as "BEAM — no size on plan". Rename them with ✏️ in the Detected list.
  • The joist check only steps in when the first pass framed nothing for a callout. On these sheets the first pass framed every joist callout, so it added nothing (tested on its own on StudioRes, 89–99% of its lines sat exactly on the first pass's joists).
  • Columns drawn only as part of a wall, with no symbol of their own, are not added. They are listed to check instead (Home2 S-1.00: one HSS10X10X5/8).
  • Home2 S-1.00 "before" counted 84 columns, but 10 of them were grid bubbles. Now 78 real columns: every column size label on the sheet has its column, except the one above. 2 columns are still unnamed.
  • Walls: waiting for your rules.
